source_vs_assumption.normalization: Reported cash, income and adjustments reconciled exactly. The 27% forward tax rate and removal of all net working-capital release are normalization conventions, not verified cash tax payments on individual extraordinary receipts.
source_vs_assumption.supplier_finance: 208 reported within accounts payable; no blanket debt reclassification. 118 reversal is a separate stress, not certified historic financing benefit.
source_vs_assumption.capital: August 1 balance, confirmed August 19 redemption. September dividend is a declared-payment reserve, not a separately verified bank debit. Post-August operating cash, FX and other unreported changes are not credited.
source_vs_assumption.claims: Operating cash 400, accrued interest annual proxy 62, legacy tax reserve 54 plus reported current tax 28 (possible overlap bounded), minority book proxy 2, finance-lease allowance 10 and contingent guarantee reserve 20.5. These are conservative estimates, not all independently verified payable balances.
source_vs_assumption.Easton: 81 reported held-for-sale carrying value receives 60.75 credit; 25% realization/tax haircut is illustrative, not verified tax basis or tax rate. Additional Easton 34 receives no credit; no sale/cash receipt invented.
source_vs_assumption.shares: 201.645313 million legal shares at August 21 plus 1 million Q2 treasury-method dilution proxy and 0.591366 million September CEO target. Not an award-by-award fully reconciled denominator. Sensitivity 201.645313 to 205.243045 million.
source_vs_assumption.SBC: Recurring SBC remains in margins; existing CEO claim represented in shares and not separately deducted at grant value. No free future buybacks; 10 million extra annual compensation cost tested.
source_vs_assumption.forecast: FY2026 sales midpoint 7054.0425. EBIT capacity bridge 879.3425 is analyst-derived, not guidance: adjusted EPS 2.70 less observed refund-related EPS effect 0.31, times 202 shares, grossed up at 27%, plus interest 250 less ordinary other income 15 and transformation costs 17.
source_vs_assumption.funded_growth: Ten-year model, all scenarios share discount rate. Capital investment is maximum of physical plus working-capital floor and positive incremental NOPAT divided by assumed incremental return. Terminal NOPAT reinvestment and physical floors continue.
source_vs_assumption.cost_of_capital: 4.88% Treasury, 4.41% dated ERP, published beta 1.33; Ke 10.7453%. Kd 8% is analyst estimate, not traded yield. Proforma nominal debt and market equity weights give WACC 8.6196195%. No-tax-shield and 9–12% sensitivities included.
source_vs_assumption.liquidity: Scenario FCFF is positive, but maintaining hypothetical dividends and paying the February 2028 maturity creates adverse/favorable two-year arithmetic deficits. Retaining dividends covers that two-year arithmetic only. Maturity occurs about 15 months after valuation, not at the end of two full forecast years; cash availability at the actual date, seasonality and any refinancing remain unverified. Combined stress is not self-funded after coupons; no unpriced financing is represented as committed.
source_vs_assumption.valuation: Conditional scenarios pending independent audit. No fair-value approval, investment entry, orders or publication authorized by this file.
